§1TWENTY-THREE STEPS, ORE TO BUNDLE§r
Fuel is made in §9twenty-three steps§r that follow the real industrial process almost exactly: mill the ore, float it, leach it, extract it, calcine it, fluorinate it, enrich it, reconvert it, press it, sinter it, grind it, clad it, load it, bundle it.

§24 pellets make a rod§r and§2 3 rods make a bundle§r.

§5THE FIVE QUESTS ON THIS ROW§r
  §9Front End§r §8- ore to yellowcake, eight steps, EV§r
  §9Conversion and the Cascade§r §8- yellowcake to enriched UF6, IV§r
  §9The Water Step§r §8- the one recipe the purified-water ladder multiplies§r
  §9Pellets, Rods, Bundles§r §8- back to the items you already know§r
  §9Reprocessing§r §8- what comes back out of the reactor§r

§5THE FOUR CONTROLLERS THIS ROW ADDS, AND HOW TO CRAFT THEM§r
All four are §9Assembler§r jobs, each built out of the casing it is walled in - and every one of those casings keeps its stock GT recipe, so there is no bootstrap loop: you can build the Batching Plant before the Batching Plant exists.
  §9Site Batching Plant§r §8EV, 30 s, circuit 14§r
   §2 8x Solid Steel Machine Casing + 4x Steel Frame Box + 2x Steel Pipe Casing + 2x Conveyor Module (EV) + 2x EV Circuit§r
    §8The cheapest of the four on purpose: it is the one you build FIRST, in order to build the silo.§r
  §9Cascade Hall§r §8IV, 45 s, circuit 15§r
   §2 8x Tungstensteel Turbine Casing + 4x Tungstensteel Pipe Casing + 4x Electric Motor (IV) + 8x Long Tungstensteel Rod + 2x Rhodium-Plated Palladium Plate + 4x IV Circuit + 1 ingot molten Platinum§r
  §9Fuel Fabrication Hall§r §8IV, 45 s, circuit 16§r
   §2 8x Clean Stainless Steel Machine Casing + 4x Tungstensteel Turbine Casing + 4x Robot Arm (IV) + 4x Conveyor Module (IV) + 2x Rhodium-Plated Palladium Plate + 4x IV Circuit + 1 ingot molten Platinum§r
  §9PUREX Canyon§r §8IV, 45 s, circuit 17§r
   §2 8x Radiation Proof Machine Casing + 4x Dense Lead Plate + 4x Electric Pump (IV) + 4x Medium Stainless Steel Pipe + 2x Rhodium-Plated Palladium Plate + 4x IV Circuit + 1 ingot molten Platinum§r

[note]Everything else in the chain runs on a machine GTNH already had - an IsaMill, a Flotation Cell, a Digester, a Chemical Plant, an LCR, a Dehydrator, a Vacuum Furnace, a Forming Press, a Lathe, a Neutron Activator, a Quantum Force Transformer, a Precise Assembler, an Assembly Line and a plain Assembler.[/note]

[note]§1The Enrichment Annex is a HEAD START on this row, not a way round it.§r§9 8x Uraninite + 2,000 L Hydrofluoric Acid -> 2x Yellowcake§r every 600 ticks - the same§2 4 Uraninite per cake§r the eight-step front end reaches by hand. It buys you §9Front End§r and nothing else; the line joins at conversion, and everything from there on is still needed.[/note]
